reviewCadence: At every rendering, consent-screen branding, HTML sanitizer, dynamic URL, custom CSS, CSP, email template, or frontend escape-hatch change.

requirements.name: Keep framework auto-escaping as the default
requirements.owasp: Modern frameworks reduce XSS when variables are rendered as text and dangerous escape hatches are controlled.

controls.name: Verified HTML escape hatch
controls.description: React raw HTML rendering is isolated behind a SafeHtml-branded VerifiedHtml component.

requirements.name: Sanitize authored HTML before rendering
requirements.owasp: HTML sanitization is required when user-authored markup must be rendered rather than encoded as text.

controls.name: SafeHtml sanitizer
controls.description: HTML sanitization strips executable tags, event handlers, style/srcdoc/action attributes, HTML comments, and unsafe URL attributes.

includes: sanitizes executable HTML before branding safe HTML

requirements.name: Validate URLs before href and src sinks
requirements.owasp: React does not sanitize javascript: or data: URLs, so dynamic URL attributes require specialized validation.

controls.name: SafeUrl attribute primitive
controls.description: Dynamic URL attributes use a SafeUrl brand that rejects scriptable protocols, encoded controls, and disallowed schemes.

requirements.name: Avoid dangerous CSS contexts
requirements.owasp: Variables in style elements and CSS contexts must be sanitized and should not be allowed to load active or remote content.

controls.name: Safe style element CSS
controls.description: Custom CSS is branded after rejecting style breakouts, imports, URL loads, legacy expressions, and scriptable protocols.

requirements.name: Reject dangerous client branding at the server boundary
requirements.owasp: Validation before storage helps preserve perfect injection resistance when data is later displayed in multiple contexts.

controls.name: Consent screen input validation
controls.description: Developer consent screen URLs must be HTTPS without credentials and custom CSS with external loads or style breakouts is rejected.

requirements.name: Encode server-generated HTML templates
requirements.owasp: Variables rendered into HTML and attributes must be contextually encoded to avoid interpreting data as markup.

controls.name: Email template escaping
controls.description: Account email templates HTML-escape replacement values and test script, tag, and attribute injection payloads.

requirements.name: Use CSP only as defense in depth
requirements.owasp: CSP can limit impact but must not replace contextual encoding, sanitization, and safe sinks.

controls.name: Shared CSP defense layer
controls.description: Web and API responses use centralized CSP with script attribute blocking, object denial, base-uri/form-action/frame-ancestors restrictions, and CSP reporting.

requirements.name: Prevent regressions
requirements.owasp: XSS controls should be enforced continuously because new sinks and framework escape hatches are easy to introduce.

controls.name: XSS prevention gate
controls.description: The root check validates registry evidence, safe primitives, consent screen usage, dangerous sink bans, tests, and package wiring.
